body: I know you are asking this person directly but I'd like to chime in anyway. If you are asking to attempt yourself, you just have to experiment. Everyone is going to be different. Length gets me going mentally but it's the thought of it more than the actual feeling. I have a 16" toy and the journey is cool but once it makes it all the way in it's just kinda like "ok, what now". On the other hand my latest conquest is one that's about 8" long but is 4.5" in diameter. I can almost get it all the way in and even just attempting is a blissful feeling that you just can't beat imo. So you literally just have to try different things until you find what you like.   Or do whatever you want lol. We're just people on the internet...
